title: VMware security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-102.031618: TT-CSIRT Advisory – VMware Security Updates
leadParagraph: VMware has released a security update stating that VMware Workstation and Fusion contain a denial-of-service vulnerability which can be triggered by opening a large number of VNC sessions.
contentHtml:
VMware has released a security update stating that VMware Workstation and Fusion contain a denial-of-service vulnerability which can be triggered by opening a large number of VNC sessions.

In order for the exploitation to take place a VNC must be manually enabled.

Further information on this vulnerability and how it can be mitigated can be found on the WMWare Website at https://www.vmware.com/security/advisories/VMSA-2018-0008.html
